parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair, made of durable plastic. It is flat and slightly contoured for comfort, typically around 40 cm wide and 40 cm deep.
parts.Functional_description: The seat supports the user's weight and provides a comfortable sitting surface. It is attached to the folding frame and can pivot when the chair is folded or unfolded.
parts.Movement_description: The seat can rotate slightly upward when the chair is folded and downward when opened for use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the folding chair, made of tubular steel. It includes the legs, backrest frame, and folding joints.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support and stability to the chair. It allows the chair to fold for compact storage and unfold for use.
parts.Movement_description: The base body includes pivot joints that enable the legs and backrest to fold inward or extend outward, allowing the chair to transition between folded and open states.
